workItem.body:
Append one characterization test for the accepted summarize contract; preserve production behavior.

Acceptance:
- Append one test to src/summary.test.mjs, preserving all 32 existing tests byte-for-byte as a prefix and preserving src/summary.mjs exactly.
- Use a frozen four-item inventory with exact primitive passed and failed statuses, a bigint status, and a frozen callable status whose Symbol.toPrimitive hook throws. Expect literal counters total=4, passed=1, failed=1, unavailable=2 without invoking the callable or coercing either unusual status.
- Verify the inventory and each status identity remain unchanged. Execute the declared candidate checks through the trusted host and cite their actual receipts. The eventual published branch guard and forge CI remain subsequent host gates; report them as pending before publication.
- Preserve product models, provider scaffolds, existing guidance, implementation policy and workflow configuration. Planning artifacts for this issue are allowed; the accepted product definition covers the behavior.

This technical seed qualifies Lighthouse #567. An isolated transport gate will pause the original automatic final-review dispatch while the default branch advances through one documentation-only commit. The unchanged admission guard must reject it before any agent or publisher runs. Native worker completion must wake the existing bounded recovery, with no owner maintenance invocation and no second merge, original CI or product apply. The control itself grants no additional delivery permission.
